A side-view illustration of a person sitting at a computer desk demonstrating proper ergonomics. The diagram has green checkmarks and labels showing: eyes level with the top of the monitor, back straight and supported by the chair, elbows bent at 90 degrees, wrists straight, and feet flat on the floor or on a footrest.

A top-down layout of a standard computer desk. Labels point out the keyboard directly in front of the user space, the mouse immediately to the right of the keyboard on a mousepad, the monitor centered behind the keyboard, and the system unit safely to the side with clear space around its back vents.

A split illustration. On the left, a dirty computer room with open windows blowing in dust, an uncovered keyboard, and a clogged cooling fan. On the right, a clean computer room with AC running, closed windows, computers protected by dust covers, and a clean cooling fan.
